limits: This verifies staged-client movement and two ordinary jump crossings from separate diagnostic login checkpoints. It does not prove a single uninterrupted camp-to-cave route, the original player's exact path or jumps, survivability under authentic final-live enemy timing/stats, or completion of the six-Thrax encounter. Long pauses between inputs make combat pacing incomparable with original footage. The staged hostile and allied combat values remain labelled reconstructions in their source manifests.
